comment: GAP: Gemeinsame Tarife (GT 8/GT 9) of ProLitteris are not in the guideline list of private instruments; treated like a GAV/AGB and marked CONTRACT_ARTICLE with the spelled-out 'Ziffer'. 'Ziffer 6 ff.' before 'und insbesondere Ziffer 8.3 der anwendbaren Tarife' left out (chain broken by 'insbesondere'; Ziffer-only without instrument is not defined). 'gemaess Ziffer 8.3' inside the quoted tariff text left unmarked (Ziffer-only, no Art./Paragraph). 'BBl 1989 III 561 Ziff. 214.4' (Botschaft in the Bundesblatt) fits none of the nine classes; left unmarked. 'SIWR II/1 ... Rz. 1413 f.' is a textbook, no span.
